chapter: Will Vodery and the road shows
title: Acts on the TOBA circuit
summary: Whaley and Hinton try to recall TOBA acts such as Butterbeans and Susie, Flo and Cecil, the Whitman Sisters and the young performers who waited for critiques.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Name me some acts back in the -- now, we're back in the '20s. Before we get to the '40s, that's 20 years, we can just -- while we're in the '20s, on the TOBA circuit. Name me some of the acts all in there. Ethyl Waters played the TOBA, right?
No, I don't think so.
I thought I read someplace where she wound up in Wiley Avenue in Pittsburgh.
She may have been there but I --
Name me some more. Miller and Lyles.
Did they have anything to do with the TOBA?
No.
Well, I want to ask you because you were there.
They were on that big time show.
Phantages...
Yeah, they were -- no, they had, like, they went on a show --
(Unintelligible.)
Like, shuffling along. They were on that kind of an act. See, they had a show, see.
Well, what kind of people were on the TOBA?
Butterbeans and Sue.

Butterbeans and Susie. There was some act named Brown, something about -- some kind of lady and her husband, named -- not Cookin' Brown, but another name with Brown. A woman and her husband. Do you remember that?
Oh, I know. Yeah. Oh, what's her name? She had a sister. Flo Brown.
Yeah. Well, what about --
Flo and Cecil. They were on.
Yeah. Well, what about the Whitmans?
Were they ever on --
The Whitmans had their own circuit. They had their own --
Tell about these -- tell me about the Whitmans. They were some black sisters in there, their own show. What was that like?
Oh, they had -- what was the boy's name? They used to have two kids. They were from the orphanage, see?
Right.
And they did a whole lot of -- but, see, I forgot a whole lot of that stuff, because --
Well, name me just the things that you remember.
Let me see, --
Like the TOBA, like you were on the TOBA. Silas Green, was he on there?

I don't know. He may have been. There was a whole lot of people that was on that show, on that circuit. That was a big circuit, because when you come into town, the kids are right there waiting for you. I want you to see my act, see.
Right.
And you'd listen to them and you'd tell them whether it was good or not, see? And -- but they don't have anything like that nowadays.
But I just thought you'd remember some-
